headline: Executive order on making online shopping safer and more lawful for consumers, businesses, government buyers, and owners of patents and trademarks.
what_it_does: This order, signed January 31, 2020, deals with safety and legal problems in online sales (e-commerce) involving the United States. Based on its title, it aims to protect shoppers, businesses, government supply chains, and people who own intellectual property such as trademarks and patents. No official summary was provided, so the specific rules, agencies, and steps it sets out are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order is meant to make products bought online safer and more lawful.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses that sell or buy goods online
who_it_affects.how: The order addresses rules or practices for lawful online commerce that may apply to them.
The order covers the safety and lawfulness of goods entering government supply chains.

who_it_affects.group: Owners of trademarks, patents, and copyrights
who_it_affects.how: The order is meant to protect their rights in online sales.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 31, 2020; specific deadlines are not stated in the available information.
